recognize_zh: 右上方的超大細胞有大量淡粉紅、細顆粒狀細胞質與多分葉的核，是成熟巨核細胞；左下方細胞較小、核大而圓、細胞質深藍且邊緣有泡狀突起，是未成熟（嗜鹼性）巨核細胞；兩者並列正好示範巨核細胞的成熟階段。
features: Very large mature megakaryocyte with abundant pale pink, finely granular cytoplasm and a compact multilobulated nucleus (upper right)
Immature megakaryocyte with a large round, dense nucleus, high N:C ratio and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with peripheral blebs (lower left)
Faint granules and budding at the periphery of the immature cell
Background mixed hematopoietic cells including erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and a band neutrophil
Scattered platelets and red cells in a thick aspirate background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows megakaryocytes at different stages of maturation. A mature megakaryocyte has abundant pale eosinophilic, finely granular cytoplasm and a lobulated nucleus, while an immature megakaryocyte has a large round nucleus with dense chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with surface blebs. The background contains trilineage hematopoietic elements without increased blasts in this field. Findings illustrate normal megakaryocytic maturation.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, evenly sized round nuclei with visible nucleoli and coarser cytoplasmic granules, whereas the megakaryocyte nucleus is a single connected lobulated mass.

ddx.dx: Dysplastic megakaryocyte with separated nuclear lobes (MDS)
ddx.vs: MDS megakaryocytes show widely separated, discrete round nuclear lobes or micromegakaryocytes with hypolobated nuclei, rather than a compact contiguous lobulated nucleus.

Megakaryoblasts are smaller with finer chromatin and nucleoli and occur in excess, and metastatic cells form cohesive clusters, whereas this immature megakaryocyte is an isolated large cell with platelet-type budding confirmed by CD61/CD42b if needed.
